title: Rasmalai and Ferrero Rocher custom cakes for Granville and Westmead families
summary:
Most custom cake requests default to vanilla or chocolate. Some Granville and Westmead families ask for something they grew up on instead.

Rasmalai and Ferrero Rocher are two of our 15 flavours, and they get ordered more than most people expect once someone in the family finds out they exist. Same rule as every other flavour: 100% eggless, no exceptions, so nobody at the table needs to ask.

Six sizes, from a 6-inch serving 6-8 to a 16-inch serving up to 55. Buttercream, fondant, or ganache finish. 48 hours minimum notice - that's what fresh baking actually takes.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. Pickup from Wigram Street, Harris Park - open until 10pm daily. We speak Hindi and Gujarati too.
